## FAQ
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2025-12-16
Meta Description: These are some of the common and frequently asked questions that might come up when using superblog.
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/faq

These are some of the common and frequently asked questions that might come up when using superblog.

## Can we track outbound links? [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#can-we-track-outbound-links "Direct link to heading")

Tracking outbound links is a common requirement for bloggers. It lets you know how often an external URL was clicked, which page the clicks occured on, etc.

Superblog provides this feature out-of-the-box. External link clicks will be tracked as events on your analytics dashboard. They will be displayed as **Outbound Link Click**, but you can expand the event to reveal the external links that have been clicked by your visitors.

![Image](https://prod.superblogcdn.com/site_cuid_cl24xk71d43671knv8xb01aas/images/faq-outbound-links-f2d26d74f492bc56cbb1630c39eb2ffa-1765879967799-compressed.png)

## Why are many pages of my superblog not indexed on Google? [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#why-are-many-pages-of-my-superblog-not-indexed-on-google "Direct link to heading")

You might be seeing that certain pages of your superblog are not indexed on Google. This can be observed from your Google Search Console or other SEO tools like Ahrefs or SEMRush.

This is 100% intentional.

They are all tag/category/navigation/comments pages (Not blog posts). They are good with no index tag. We are not blocking Google to read it, we are only asking not to index those pages to avoid competition among your own pages.

That's the whole point of superblog. You don't need to worry about these SEO best practices. They come with the platform.

## Why is the content pasted from google docs and other sources badly formatted? [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#why-is-the-content-pasted-from-google-docs-and-other-sources-badly-formatted "Direct link to heading")

This is a common issue for text editors. Pasting content from outside sources will cause formatting issues.

### How to avoid this issue [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#how-to-avoid-this-issue "Direct link to heading")

You can export your content from Google Docs or Notion or other sources into .docx, or .html, or .md (markdown) files and then import that files into Superblog for seamless experience.

Read more: [https://superblog.ai/docs/dashboard/posts#import-post](https://superblog.ai/docs/dashboard/posts#import-post)

## Can we add author info/bio below the blog posts? [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#can-we-add-author-infobio-below-the-blog-posts "Direct link to heading")

Yes. You can have complete author profile for each team member.

## Why the pagespeed score is low for my Superblog? [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#why-the-pagespeed-score-is-low-for-my-superblog "Direct link to heading")

Superblog targets for 90+ score in Google's Lighthouse Audit on an average (combination of all the scores). If your superblog has less than 90, then the below could be possible reasons:

1. You might have added large Javascript to your superblog.
2. You might have added large embeds in your blog post. (ex: twitter threads, apple podcasts, etc).
3. You might have embedded Youtube player directly using embed code. Instead, embed it by clicking "Video" icon in the post editor's toolbar.
4. You have added Google Analytics or Gtag scripts (there is an inbuilt tracking module for superblog which is lightweight) or maybe you are using custom tracking scripts that could be causing an issue.
5. If you configured your superblog on a subdirectory (for example: yourwebsite.com/blog), then the request will hit your server first to handle the reverse proxy. So please check if it is causing delays in response and rewrites (proxy) which will reduce the pagescores.
6. You might be auditing the home page of your superblog. You should audtiting the post URL to get the accurate scores.

## Why the lighthouse (core web vitals) assessment failed for blog URLs? [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#why-the-lighthouse-core-web-vitals-assessment-failed-for-blog-urls "Direct link to heading")

This will happen only when you are using superblog on a subdirectory due to the below reasons. Just click on the `i` icon as shown in the below image.

![Image](https://prod.superblogcdn.com/site_cuid_cl24xk71d43671knv8xb01aas/images/faq-cwv-failed-6dd4ce790d519db956a5331d7b2963ef-1765879967520-compressed.jpeg)

1. If you click on the `i` icon as shown in the above image, you will understand that the real world data is not available for this particular URL and hence Google is showing the aggregate data for the entire website (including ALL your pages, not just blog). So, this is not a problem from superblog's side. You need to fix your website's performance.

2. Since you are using superblog on a subdirectory (for example: yourwebsite.com/blog), then the request will hit your server first to handle the reverse proxy. So please check if it is causing delays in response and rewrites (proxy).


## Why do I see my blog post URLs twice in Google Search Console or other Analytics solutions? [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#why-do-i-see-my-blog-post-urls-twice-in-google-search-console-or-other-analytics-solutions "Direct link to heading")

If you haven't configured redirect of URLs ending with and without forward slash (/), then you will see 2 urls of same post in your analytics solution (could be search console or google analytics, etc.) as the users could end up on different versions of the URL. (but google will only index one URL, i.e, your preffered URL because superblog sets canonical URL by default).

Example:

[https://mywebsite.com/blog/my-post-abc](https://mywebsite.com/blog/my-post-abc)

[https://mywebsite.com/blog/my-post-abc/](https://mywebsite.com/blog/my-post-abc/)

You might need to set a redirect one URL to other (your preferred URL) on your server.
This only happens if you configured superblog on your subdirectory.

## What is the sitemap URL for my superblog? [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#what-is-the-sitemap-url-for-my-superblog "Direct link to heading")

Your superblog's sitemap.xml is always at the root.

For example:

[https://blog.yourwebsite.com/sitemap.xml](https://blog.yourwebsite.com/sitemap.xml) (subdomain)

[https://yourwebsite.com/blog/sitemap.xml](https://yourwebsite.com/blog/sitemap.xml) (subdirectory)

## Why are my latest posts not getting indexed on Google? [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#why-are-my-latest-posts-not-getting-indexed-on-google "Direct link to heading")

Make sure your site's configuration is correct.
Your website's robots.txt should contain your [superblog's sitemap](#what-is-the-sitemap-url-for-my-superblog).

Here's a example of correct config:
[https://superblog.ai/robots.txt](https://superblog.ai/robots.txt)

### Note [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#note "Direct link to heading")

1. First of all, google has a certain crawl budget for each website. Depending on your content quality, age of website, no number articles, etc. google will crawl your website at a certain rate.
2. If you list your blog post URLs manually in your sitemap.xml then you can skip mentioning your superblog's sitemap in the robots.txt. However, just do it no matter what.
3. If the problem remains even after the above, try to manually index the URLs in Google Search Console.
4. If the problem remains even after the above, your content is of low quality.

## How to automatically approve comments from a specific user? [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#how-to-automatically-approve-comments-from-a-specific-user "Direct link to heading")

Generally, users need to approve their comments before they are published on your blog by verifying their email address every time they post a comment.

But if you want to approve comments from a specific user automatically, then you can do it by following the below steps.

1. Open the specific post in your dashboard and click on the "Advanced Options" button.
2. You will see a button called "View Comments", click on it.
3. Then click on "Approve Email" next to the email address of the comment you want to approve.

From now on, all the comments from that user email will be automatically approved and published on your blog. You can disapprove the email anytime by clicking the "Disapprove Email" button.

## Magic link for email sign in is invalid [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#magic-link-for-email-sign-in-is-invalid "Direct link to heading")

Two reasons:

1. The link must have expired (15 minutes max validity)
2. Your email provider/client might have scanned the link in your email inbox which invalidated it. (it is a one-time usage link)

## Did not receive the magic link? [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#did-not-receive-the-magic-link "Direct link to heading")

If you didn't receive the magic link, check your spam or junk folder. Sometimes emails can get filtered there. If you still don't see it, try requesting a new link.

## Why is my superblog subdomain indexed on Google? [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#why-is-my-superblog-subdomain-indexed-on-google "Direct link to heading")

For example: mysite.superblog.cloud.

It means you haven't configured your custom domain fast enough before Google indexed your content. Do not worry, once you configure your custom domain, Google will remove the superblog domain from search results because canonical URL is set to your custom domain automatically. The subdomain will be live because of how the tech works and Google will know the actual page URL via canonical URL and sitemap.

## Why is the meta title and meta description different in Google search results? [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#why-is-the-meta-title-and-meta-description-different-in-google-search-results "Direct link to heading")

Google is known to automatically rewrite meta tags. Superblog publishes exactly what you wrote in dashboard. Read more: [https://www.searchenginejournal.com/google-changes-more-than-61-percent-of-title-tags/435618/](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/google-changes-more-than-61-percent-of-title-tags/435618/)

You can view HTML source to confirm or install any plugin in chrome to see your metadata.

## Why the `<lastmod>` for post url is different than the last updated value of the post? [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#why-the-lastmod-for-post-url-is-different-than-the-last-updated-value-of-the-post "Direct link to heading")

For sitemap `<lastmod>` dates, you should use the timestamp when the actual URL content was last modified. For example, if you updated your navigation menu, then the `<lastmod>` for all the post urls should be updated to the timestamp of that update.

Here's the reasoning and best practices:
What `<lastmod>` represents:
The `<lastmod>` element tells search engines when the content at that specific URL was last changed. This includes any visible changes to the page, not just the core content like blog post text.
In your scenario:
Even though your blog post content hasn't changed in a week, the page itself has been modified because:

The navigation menu is part of the page content
The HTML structure/output has changed
Users visiting the URL will see different content than before

Therefore, you should use the timestamp when the page was regenerated with the new menu.

## Tags
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2025-12-16
Category: Dashboard
Category URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/category/dashboard
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/dashboard-tags

`View Dashboard > Tags`

You can add multiple tags to each post. All the tags added to different posts are showed in `Tags` section. You can edit or delete a tag by clicking the respective icon.

![Image](https://prod.superblogcdn.com/site_cuid_cl24xk71d43671knv8xb01aas/images/tags-bb0ee42a06a0f6e9988ff6de534e3048-1765879966495-compressed.png)

## Note [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#note "Direct link to heading")

1. A common bad practice followed by beginners is to add too many tags to a post. Do NOT add too many tags to a post.

For example, consider a post with title **"Best software to check grammar misatkes in paragraphs"**.

You can add tags like "software" , "writing tools". That's it! Do not stuff so many keywords. It won't help in SEO.

2. If a post has no category assigned then the first tag of the post is displayed below the post title on the homepage.

## Menu
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2025-12-16
Category: Dashboard
Category URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/category/dashboard
Meta Description: View Dashboard > Menu
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/dashboard-menu

`View Dashboard > Menu`

Superblog has a beautiful navigation menu options to help your blog's visitors browse your blog. There are two menus available.

1. Navigation Menu
2. Footer Menu

## Navigation Menu [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#navigation-menu "Direct link to heading")

![Image](https://prod.superblogcdn.com/site_cuid_cl24xk71d43671knv8xb01aas/images/menu-nav-sample-43c49959f208daa5f1be47057f4a7464-1765879950266-compressed.png)

## Footer Menu [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#footer-menu "Direct link to heading")

![Image](https://prod.superblogcdn.com/site_cuid_cl24xk71d43671knv8xb01aas/images/menu-footer-sample-1d347b25b2406c42ae5ed891776015ed-1765879950185-compressed.png)

## Menu items [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#menu-items "Direct link to heading")

You can manage the menu items from dashboard. They can be edited, deleted or rearranged by dragging across the list to edit the navigation menu. You can also add nested items (dropdown menu).

You need to enter an absolute URL for the menu item's destination. For example: " [http://my-website.com/sample-path"](http://my-website.com/sample-path%22).

![Image](https://prod.superblogcdn.com/site_cuid_cl24xk71d43671knv8xb01aas/images/menu-add-211bee69a08cb8b0092fceb39b014bdb-1765879950197-compressed.png)

![Image](https://prod.superblogcdn.com/site_cuid_cl24xk71d43671knv8xb01aas/images/menu-dropdown-d4dce935c9819e48e21e8f9fc17850c4-1765879950334-compressed.png)

## Call to action button (CTA) [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#call-to-action-button-cta "Direct link to heading")

You can have a CTA button in your menu to drive blog traffic to your product/app/landing page. The last item in the menu items automatically becomes a CTA button.

![Image](https://prod.superblogcdn.com/site_cuid_cl24xk71d43671knv8xb01aas/images/menu-sample-cta-692c5208cc29d69d03cc5d980880476e-1765879951046-compressed.png)

## Settings

## Settings

`View Dashboard > Settings`

You can customize your Superblog in almost every aspect possible.

There are some sane restrictions in place to make sure that the user experience and reading experience are not compromised.

Settings are divided into sections for easier use.

1. General

2. Design

3. Homepage

4. Menu

5. SEO

6. Multilingual

7. Integrations

Each section has various options that are pretty self-explanatory. You can find common settings to customize template, colors, names, labels, translations, redirects, robots.txt custom JavaScript, custom CSS and a bunch of other things here.

## Deploy
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2025-12-16
Category: Dashboard
Category URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/category/dashboard
Meta Description: Whenever you make any change in your Superblog like updating settings, adding a new post, editing a post, or anything else you can see the "Deploy" button is activated. It is seen in the top right of the dashboard.
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/dashboard-deploy

Whenever you make any change in your Superblog like updating settings, adding a new post, editing a post, or anything else, you can see that the **"Deploy"** button is activated. It is seen in the top right of the dashboard.

You need to click the "Deploy" button to make those changes live. You do NOT need to click "Deploy" after every change. Instead, make all the changes you want and then **Deploy** **once** in the end. **ONCE**.

You will get an email alert after your Superblog is deployed.

![](https://prod.superblogcdn.com/site_cuid_cl24xk71d43671knv8xb01aas/images/screenshot-2025-12-17-at-12-1765974128351-compressed.png)

## **Why does it take time to** deploy **?** [**​**](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#why-does-it-take-time-to-deploy)

You might have noticed that Superblog is blazing fast when compared to WordPress, Medium, Ghost, and almost any other blogging platform out there. It is because Superblog uses a new technology.

If you click the ‘Deploy’ button then your entire blog is re-built into small bits and pieces. Then those are optimized for Speed and SEO to be stored in multiple locations around the world (CDN). That's why it takes a minute or two to deploy.

When a visitor wants to read your blog, it is served from a server that is located nearest to that visitor.

## What is deploy limit? [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#what-is-deploy-limit)

If you have received an email that says "You have reached deploy limit" then do not panic. It is simply a measure to prevent abuse of the platform.

The best approach is to make a number of changes (like updating settings, editing existing posts, publishing a new post, changing theme color, etc.,) and then click the 'Deploy' button ONCE at the end.

However, if you need more quota for a day, you can write an email to support to get it reset.

## Activate the deploy button [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#activate-the-deploy-button)

If **Deploy** button is disabled for some reason then you can click on the **Question Mark** next to the deploy button to activate it manually.

![Image](https://prod.superblogcdn.com/site_cuid_cl24xk71d43671knv8xb01aas/images/deploy-activate-09ea2ae547fa86849c8cd6bd0f7dadc8-1765879948051-compressed.png)

## Pro Tip [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#pro-tip)

Deploy button gets activated whenever you make a change in your dashboard. For example: edit a post, change a setting, add a menu item, etc.

Instead of clicking deploy each time, you can perform all activities and click **deploy once in the end**.


---
This blog is powered by Superblog. Visit https://superblog.ai to know more.

## Create an account
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2025-12-16
Category: Get Started
Category URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/category/get-started
Meta Description: To use Superblog, you need to have a valid email address. To explore the product, we offer you a free 14-day trial. No credit card is required to sign up for the trial.
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/get-started-create-an-account

To use Superblog, you need to have a valid email address. To explore the product, we offer you a 7-day free trial. No credit card is required.

There are a few sensible limitations to prevent abuse of the platform.

## Signup / Login [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#signup--login)

You can simply login with your Google account or use any email address to receive a magic link to login. Your account is created automatically.

![Image](https://prod.superblogcdn.com/site_cuid_cl24xk71d43671knv8xb01aas/images/login-6c55140957a5a79ade8543c755a7317b-1765879968370-compressed.png)

## Magic Link [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#magic-link)

If you enter your email address to login to Superblog then you will receive an email with login link. Click on the **"Login to dashboard"** button.

### Note [​](https://superblog.ai/docs/\#note)

1. This link is valid for 15 minutes only. You can request 3 magic links in a 24-hour window. If you try to request more, you will see an error: "Exceeded login attempts."
2. If you use Office 365, Outlook, or another email provider, you may notice that magic links are not working. This is because your email service scanned the magic link and consumed it. You need to add superblog.ai to your safe links list in Office 365 or your email provider's settings.

## Migrate from Medium to Superblog
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna

Tags: Tutorials
Tag URLs: Tutorials (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/tutorials)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/migrate-from-medium-to-superblog-cl26cpcbp244691jo6giihwyw2

You can import your existing Medium posts to Superblog in less than 1 minute.

1. Create a Superblog.
2. Visit your Dashboard.
3. Click ‘ **Site Data**’ in the left sidebar navigation.
4. Click ‘ **Import from Medium**’ button in the ‘Site Data’ section.
5. Now, you will see a popup asking you to enter your Medium’s username.

If your medium’s address is **abcd.medium.com**, then you need to enter **abcd**.

If your medium’s address is **medium.com/@xyz**, then you need to enter **xyz**.

## How to embed content into my posts?

## Access superblog content via API
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-19
Tags: Tutorials
Tag URLs: Tutorials (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/tutorials)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/access-superblog-content-via-api-cl26ckjd5241761jo6oczk6ekr

Superblog is designed from the ground up to be compatible with other software stacks. So, it’s very easy to access your superblog’s posts, tags, authors, etc via API.

If [example.com/blog](http://example.com/blog) is your superblog’s URL then this is your RSS feed: [https://example.com/blog/rss.xml 1](https://example.com/blog/rss.xml)

You can do a **GET** request and render the response data (most recent posts) on mobile or website.

It is RSS 2.0 spec-compliant and hence can be used with any other software too. for example zapier or zohoworkflow.

### Sample JS code:

```hljs javascript
const fetch = require('node-fetch-polyfill');
const convert = require('xml-js');

 const res = await fetch('https://superblog.ai/blog/rss.xml'); // change this URL to your blog's URL
        const data = await res.text();
        const rssData = convert.xml2js(data);
        const postNodes = rssData.elements[0].elements[0].elements.filter((e) => e.name === 'item');
        const rssPosts = postNodes.map((pn) => {
            return {
                title: pn.elements[0].elements[0].text,
                link: pn.elements[1].elements[0].text,
                description: pn.elements[2].elements[0].cdata,
                pubDate: pn.elements[3].elements[0].text,
            };
        });

```

 **Real world examples:**

RSS Feed: [https://superblog.ai/blog/rss.xml 1](https://superblog.ai/blog/rss.xml)

See the “Blog Posts” section here [https://superblog.ai/ 1](https://superblog.ai/)

**Note:**

This is the most effective way for front-end developers to read your blog’s content.

In case if you want to build a custom solution on top of Superblog’s CMS, the entire Superblog dashboard is built using REST standards. There is no documentation for that but you can view Chrome’s developer tools to figure the rest endpoints and use that in your custom application.


---
This blog is powered by Superblog. Visit https://superblog.ai to know more.

## Create a Superblog and connect your domain in 2 minutes 
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-19
Tags: Tutorials
Tag URLs: Tutorials (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/tutorials)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/create-a-superblog-and-connect-your-domain-in-2-minutes-cl26cg4up238951jo6iwmam1mc

## Video Tutorial

## Text Tutorial

Login at ​ [https://write.superblog.ai](https://write.superblog.ai) ​

1. Click **create new site**.
2. Enter a **site name**. This will be public and visible in the header if no logo is uploaded. Ex: Robin’s Blog
3. Choose a **unique name** for your blog’s address. This will be your public address if you don’t have a custom domain. Ex: **robin**.superblog.cloud
4. Give a **description** of your site so that people can read it and visit your main website. This will be displayed below every blog post.
5. Click **manage** on your site and navigate to ‘ **Domain**’ section in the sidebar.​

## Connect Your Domain

1. You can connect your own domain to superblog. Ex: [robin.com/blog 2](http://robin.com/blog) or [blog.robin.com](http://blog.robin.com/) or [robin.com](http://robin.com/).
2. The instructions are shown on the same screen after you connect your domain.
3. Messing with DNS settings can be intimidating, no worries, detailed instructions are shown on the same screen.

​

## Migrate from WordPress to Superblog
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-19
Tags: Tutorials
Tag URLs: Tutorials (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/tutorials)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/migrate-from-wordpress-to-superblog-cl26cbafd237271jo6i1sab69f

You can import your existing WordPress posts to Superblog in less than five minutes with one click.

1. Create a Superblog.
2. Visit your Dashboard by clicking ‘ **View Dashboard**’.
3. Click ‘ **Data**’ in the left sidebar navigation.
4. Click the ‘ **Import from WordPress'** button in the ‘Data’ section.

Now, you will see a popup asking you to enter your WordPress blog’s URL.

![migrate from superblog to wordpress](https://prod.superblogcdn.com/site_cuid_cl24xk71d43671knv8xb01aas/images/a74d5b9466c65577e7799ffadb96948dbe6cb4cc2690x402-1650384672531-compressed.png)

You need to give the URL of your WordPress installation and not the vanity URL of the blog.

For example, if your WordPress installation is at the root URL of your domain called [mysamplesite.com](http://mysamplesite.com/) then enter [http://mysamplesite.com](http://mysamplesite.com/) (if you have SSL, then https).

Some people might be confused about it because they have their blog at [MySampleSite.com is for sale \| HugeDomains](http://mysamplesite.com/blog) and tend to enter that URL. Always enter the URL of your WordPress installation as mentioned above.

**Special cases:**

1. Sometimes, your root domain will be [mysamplesite.com](http://mysamplesite.com/) and your WordPress is installed in [MySampleSite.com is for sale \| HugeDomains](http://mysamplesite.com/blog), then you need to enter [https://mysamplesite.com/blog](https://mysamplesite.com/blog).
2. If your WordPress is installed at [https://blog.mysamplesite.com](https://blog.mysamplesite.com/) then enter [https://blog.mysamplesite.com](https://blog.mysamplesite.com/).


---
This blog is powered by Superblog. Visit https://superblog.ai to know more.
---

## How to set the cover image/thumbnail for the post?

## Can I reassign the post to a different author? 
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-19
Category: FAQ
Category URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/category/faq
Tags: FAQ
Tag URLs: FAQ (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/faq)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/can-i-reassign-the-post-to-a-different-author-cl26c7ep5234451jo6sp81iszz

Yes! You can reassign the posts to any member of your team.

But caution, only Admin or Site Owner can reassign the posts.

1. Click on the post you want to change the author for.
2. On the right-hand side, you can find ‘Author’ details.
3. Simply click on the name or image icon to change the author.

## Can I embed external scripts into superblog? 
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-19

Category URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/category/faq

Tag URLs: FAQ (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/faq)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/can-i-embed-external-scripts-into-superblog-cl26bum3x224781jo6iyavo8y3

Yes! You can add external javascript code or widget embed code or tracking pixels into your superblog.

For example:- Facebook Pixel, Hubspot Tracking Code, Freshchat widget or Plausible Analytics or any other service code can be embedded.

**How to:**

1. Visit your Superblog dashboard
2. Go Settings>Expert section.
3. Copy paste the javascript code in “Misc Scripts” textbox.

Then Save and click Deploy button.

## Should I purchase an SSL separately?
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-19
Category: FAQ
Category URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/category/faq
Tags: FAQ
Tag URLs: FAQ (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/faq)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/should-i-purchase-an-ssl-separately-cl26bu76p224261jo6b101h4f4

You don’t need to buy.

Superblog gives a free SSL (generated by [Let’s Encrypt](https://letsencrypt.org/)) for your blog.

If you host your superblog on a subdomain ( [blog.example.com](http://blog.example.com/)), then you can utilize the free SSL.

If you host superblog on subdirectory ( [example.com/blog](http://example.com/blog)), then the SSL present on your main domain will be sufficient. Superblog can’t generate an SSL for your main domain.


---
This blog is powered by Superblog. Visit https://superblog.ai to know more.
---

## What are the SEO best Practices shown on editor page?
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-19
Category: FAQ
Category URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/category/faq
Tags: FAQ
Tag URLs: FAQ (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/faq)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/what-are-the-seo-best-practices-shown-on-editor-page-cl26bstgz223491jo6mbjmjywf

You might have seen **SEO Best Practices** on the post editor page. Let us try to understand what they are.

![superblog seo best practices](https://prod.superblogcdn.com/site_cuid_cl24xk71d43671knv8xb01aas/images/b32401e6a0dd9a6173b9ad34055eed00c6ac3043-1650383660235-compressed.png)

## Title

This is the title of the post. Make sure your post’s title is around 8-12 words and has your post’s keyword.

## Content

This is the contents of your post.

## Images

Always include images in your posts. A picture is worth 1000 words.

## Headings

Format your content properly. You need to have at least two headings. Write a catchy sentence to explain the section of your post and use the “Heading” format from the toolbar. Internally superblog will convert a heading to h2 which is good for SEO.

## Subheadings

Format your content properly. You need to have at least 1 subheading. “Subheading” format from the toolbar. Internally superblog will convert a heading to h3 which is good for SEO.

## Tags

You need to tag your post with relevant topics. For example, if you are writing a post on “Impact of covid in 2021 on health care industry” then you use tags like covid, healthcare, planning etc.

You can add the tags from the right-side “tag” editor.

## Internal links

This is a very high-level SEO concept. All your blog posts should link to each other. So, make sure that you add a link to posts on your blog.

For example, let us assume you have a post on your blog with the topic of “Understanding economics of scale”. If you are writing a new post with the topic of “Scaling a business with 3 proven ways” then make sure you add a link to your previous post.


---
This blog is powered by Superblog. Visit https://superblog.ai to know more.
---

## Why is the content pasted from google docs and other sources badly formatted?
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-19
Category: FAQ
Category URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/category/faq
Tags: FAQ
Tag URLs: FAQ (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/faq)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/why-is-the-content-pasted-from-google-docs-and-other-sources-badly-formatted-cl26brhdp222901jo6wnwvhegw

This is a common issue for text editors. Pasting content from outside sources will cause formatting issues.

### How to avoid this issue

You can export your content from Google Docs or Notion or other sources into .docx, or .html, or .md (markdown) files and then import that files into Superblog for seamless experience.

Read more: [https://superblog.ai/docs/dashboard/posts#import-post](https://superblog.ai/docs/dashboard/posts#import-post) ​

## I connected a domain but opening my blog throws an error: Your connection isn’t private
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-19
Category: FAQ
Category URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/category/faq
Tags: FAQ
Tag URLs: FAQ (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/faq)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/i-connected-a-domain-but-opening-my-blog-throws-an-error-your-connection-isnt-private-cl26bq2jd222461jo6qns1eqj8

Looks like you just connected your domain or subdomain to superblog. (Yay!! Welcome to Superblog Federation).

DNS records will take some time for complete propagation. Once it is done, superblog will assign an SSL. Typical domain providers (like godaddy, namecheap) say propagation will take 24-48 hours. Most of the times, it will happen in less than 1 hour.

So, please be patient until the DNS propagation is complete.


---
This blog is powered by Superblog. Visit https://superblog.ai to know more.
---

## How does the ToC plugin work?
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-19
Category: FAQ
Category URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/category/faq
Tags: FAQ
Tag URLs: FAQ (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/faq)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/how-does-the-toc-plugin-work-cl26bhwmp220601jo69klq2o5q

The table of contents is automatically generated for each post.

By default only the H2 titles are shown. If required you can enable to show H3 headings as well.

You can also control table of contents to be hidden throughout your blog or per-post basis.

If you want to disable the ToC on any post, you can do so from the "Advanced Options" of each post. You can also control this setting globally via "Settings > Expert"


---
This blog is powered by Superblog. Visit https://superblog.ai to know more.
---

## Do I get a refund when I cancel the subscription?

Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna

URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/do-i-get-a-refund-when-i-cancel-the-subscription-cl26beroh218011jo65wmktud8

You can cancel your subscription anytime.

In the case of yearly plans, you will get a refund on a pro-rata basis excluding the month of cancellation and payment gateway’s charges. Please write to hello@superblog.ai afterward.

In the case of monthly plans, you won’t get any refund.


No.

Yes.

## Alternative Text vs Insert Description
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-19
Tags: FAQ
Tag URLs: FAQ (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/faq)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/alternative-text-vs-insert-description-cl26b03z3214611jo6pst3348b

Alternative text is shown when an Image isn’t available. (standard web practice)

When you check the “insert description”, you can enter the text below the image which is visible always.


---

## Is there a newsletter/subscription feature?
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-19
Category: FAQ
Category URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/category/faq
Tags: FAQ
Tag URLs: FAQ (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/faq)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/is-there-a-newsletter/subscription-feature-cl269b8om0120cglh934jag20

No. Superblog is built for businesses.

But there is a lead-generation form that is shown below every post (you can see the screenshots attached below). You can customize it from the dashboard. The reason for this is the probability of a reader filling the lead-gen/inquiry form is much much higher than a subscription form.

Once your readers fill the form, you get an email alert and you can manage them from your superblog dashboard. You can download that list to integrate with any other mailing solution or Connect Superblog to Zapier to setup automation to use with 1000s of apps.

![superblog lead generation form](https://prod.superblogcdn.com/site_cuid_cl24xk71d43671knv8xb01aas/images/screenshot-2022-04-19-at-8-1650379756398-compressed.png)![superblog newsletter feature](https://prod.superblogcdn.com/site_cuid_cl24xk71d43671knv8xb01aas/images/screenshot-2022-04-19-at-8-1650379782531-compressed.png)

**Note**

This is feature is disabled during trial period to prevent abuse of the platform.

This blog is powered by Superblog. Visit https://superblog.ai to know more.

## What is logout from all sessions?
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-19
Category: FAQ
Category URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/category/faq
Tags: FAQ
Tag URLs: FAQ (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/faq)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/what-is-logout-from-all-sessions-cl269b8ol0119cglhrnth3vli

![superblog logout from everywhere](https://prod.superblogcdn.com/site_cuid_cl24xk71d43671knv8xb01aas/images/6df10c9b5ade33cb53d36234b56e94cd5110b5222690x454-1650380084703-compressed.png)

You will find this button on [My Account](https://write.superblog.ai/account) page. When you click this button, you will be signed out of all session wherever you logged into superblog dashboard.

For example, assume that you logged into a superblog dashboard from a public machine. But you forgot to logout! No worries, you can login to superblog dashboard from any machine and then visit “My Account page” to click “Logout All Sessions” button. Now, your active session from the earlier public machine is also logged out!


---
This blog is powered by Superblog. Visit https://superblog.ai to know more.

## How to speed up DNS propagation?
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-19
Category: FAQ
Category URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/category/faq
Tags: Tutorials
Tag URLs: Tutorials (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/tutorials)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/how-to-speed-up-dns-propagation-cl269b8ok0114cglh4ydd2a7c

Whenever you connect a new domain name to your server or add a new subdomain or modify DNS records for your domain, you can speed up the propagation by clearing the cached values from popular public databases like Google, Cloudflare, etc.

Typically, your provider might say to wait for 24-72 hours but you can try to speedup the process by using the links below to clear cached records in popular public DNS servers:

- [Flush Google Public DNS Cache](https://developers.google.com/speed/public-dns/cache)
- [Purge Cloudflare Public DNS Cache](https://1.1.1.1/purge-cache/)
- [Refresh OpenDNS Cache](https://cachecheck.opendns.com/)


---
This blog is powered by Superblog. Visit https://superblog.ai to know more.
---

## What is the ideal image size required to fit in the post&rsquo;s cover image?
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-19
Tags: FAQ
Tag URLs: FAQ (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/faq)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/what-is-the-ideal-image-size-required-to-fit-in-the-postandrsquos-cover-image-cl269b8ok0113cglhkrk44gys

Superblog uses the first image in a post as the cover image (banner image) for the post.

The ratio of the cover image is 3:2 (width: height) and the images you upload will be scaled without losing proportions accordingly.

You can upload the first image to be in the ratio of 3:2 (width:height) to be displayed correctly in the cover image.


---
This blog is powered by Superblog. Visit https://superblog.ai to know more.

## Connect Superblog leads to Zapier
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-19
Tags: Tutorials
Tag URLs: Tutorials (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/tutorials)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/connect-superblog-leads-to-zapier-cl269b8oi0108cglhiq1brehg

You can connect superblog to Zapier using official Superblog Integration.

1. Create an API Key [as shown here](https://superblog.ai/docs/create-api-keys-cl269b8oi0109cglh7zy7o8x9).

2. Search for Superblog in Zapier to create a Zap.

3. Paste the API Key obtained in step #1 into the superblog app on Zapier.

4. Choose your destination and configure it to finish the Zap.


From now on, whenever you receive a lead your Zap will make sure it will end up in your zapped location.


---
This blog is powered by Superblog. Visit https://superblog.ai to know more.

## How many tags can we add per post?

You can add as many tags as you want to a post and they are automatically inserted as meta keywords.

**p.s:**

Sometimes, users do keyword stuffing. Which is frowned upon. Instead, use keywords in post content meaningfully. Also, google doesn’t consider “meta keywords” for ranking anymore. The whole weightage is in post content.

## Migrate from Ghost to superblog

## Why is stripe flagging my transaction?
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-19
Category: FAQ
Category URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/category/faq
Tags: FAQ
Tag URLs: FAQ (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/faq)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/why-is-stripe-flagging-my-transaction-cl269b8o50095cglhc7psvajg

In rare cases, stripe flags a transaction as high-risk. This commonly happens due to the usage of VPN.

Do not use a VPN when you try to make payments.

Also, stripe tries to take other factors like location, card’s issuer country, IP address, email id etc in to consideration when evaluating a payment transaction.


---
This blog is powered by Superblog. Visit https://superblog.ai to know more.
---

## Why are the anchor tags marked as nofollow?
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-19
Tags: FAQ
Tag URLs: FAQ (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/faq)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/why-are-the-anchor-tags-marked-as-nofollow-cl269b8o00084cglhdm07fhue

Superblog automatically adds `nofollow` attribute to anchor tags if you are in the trial period.

This is to prevent abuse of the platform by spammers who are looking for free backlinks

## Trying to login with magic link says invalid or expired
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-19
Category: FAQ
Category URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/category/faq
Tags: FAQ
Tag URLs: FAQ (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/faq)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/trying-to-login-with-magic-link-says-invalid-or-expired-cl269b8nz0082cglh489a05eg

When you try to re-use the same link to login, you will see the following error:

> `It may have been already used or expired`

The magic sign-in link becomes invalid if you click on the link once. This is done as a security measure.

In case you want to share the login link with someone, just forward the email to them so that they click the “Login” button to sign into superblog dashboard.

### Special scenario

In case your email provider has automatic security scanning of links then the magic link will be processed by your email provider and that's why it becomes invalid or expired.


---
This blog is powered by Superblog. Visit https://superblog.ai to know more.
---

## Migrate from Webflow to Superblog
Author: Sai Krishna
Author URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/author/sai-krishna
Published: 2022-04-18
Tags: Tutorials
Tag URLs: Tutorials (https://superblog.ai/docs/tag/tutorials)
URL: https://superblog.ai/docs/migrate-from-webflow-to-superblog-cl251c2l157131knv8puxy1ap

You can import your existing Webflow blog posts to Superblog in less than five minutes with one click.

1. Create a Superblog.
2. Visit your Dashboard by clicking ‘ **Manage**’.
3. Click ‘ **Data**’ in the left sidebar navigation.
4. Click the ‘ **Import from Webflow**’ button in the ‘Site Data’ section.

Now, you will see a popup asking you to enter your Webflow details.

![](https://prod.superblogcdn.com/site_cuid_cl24xk71d43671knv8xb01aas/images/0d82bb013278b98224296a22400a8c21e5b3419b2690x476-1650350580906-compressed.png)

API key

1. Visit your **Webflow Dashboard**.
2. Go to your site>settings>integrations.
3. Scroll down to see the **“Generate new API token”** button and click it.
4. Copy-paste the API token in the above form.

## Post Collection Id

You might have created a CMS collection to create posts on your webflow site. You can visit the CMS section of your webflow site and find the ID in the settings.

![](https://prod.superblogcdn.com/site_cuid_cl24xk71d43671knv8xb01aas/images/cd7c86d7565a4a3a352c096941d6ebcb42d247102690x295-1650350627672-compressed.png)

Post Body Field

You might have created the Post model with certain fields in Webflow CMS. You need to enter the name of the field that holds the content of your post during migration.

For example, I created a **“content”** field to hold the post body in my CMS. It could be **“post-body”, “post-content”, etc** in your CMS depending on who created it.

![](https://prod.superblogcdn.com/site_cuid_cl24xk71d43671knv8xb01aas/images/45bc51e112b4887a6caa7e18b9081b800b4a5010-1650350642947-compressed.png)


---
This blog is powered by Superblog. Visit https://superblog.ai to know more.
---
